errors.text_span: 图表的水平轴（X轴）表示不同的实体类别
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis (X-axis) represents the numerical values ('实体数目', or number of entities), not the categories. The categories are on the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: 垂直轴（Y轴）表示实体数目
errors.evidence: The vertical axis (Y-axis) lists the different categories, not the numerical entity counts.
The numerical axis has evenly spaced intervals of 1000, as shown by the tick marks at 0, 1000, 2000, 3000, and 4000.
This is a horizontal bar chart, so it is the length of the bars, not their height, that represents the quantity.
